title: Director, Quality Engineering Production Support
text:
Develop and implement strategies to enhance product quality and compliance. Manage team members to lead multiple quality operations projects that support the manufacture of medical devices. Assist executives and/or senior directors in defining organizational goals and strategic plans. Collaborate closely with management and staff in Manufacturing, R&D, Regulatory, and other Quality areas to support manufacturing process changes, manufacturing transfers, product design improvements and transfers, implementation of new products, and the enhancement of quality management system compliance. As owner of product non-conformance procedure, responsible for timely execution and closure, implementation of actions, corrections, material disposition, monitoring performance of the NCR process, and providing KPI’s to the Quality Leadership team.
 
 
Working with senior quality management, develop and implement strategies to enhance product quality and compliance
 
2. Develop guidelines and complex processes/procedures for quality engineering groups to enhance performance
 
3. Manage managers, engineers, and technicians who support the manufacture of medical devices
 
4. Manage managers and quality engineers who work with Manufacturing Engineering and R&D to review process changes and resolve quality issues
 
5. Manage quality engineers who lead activities to investigate corrective actions associated with nonconforming product and customer complaints
 
6. Manage quality engineers who lead projects to improve the quality management system, including remediation projects and cost reduction opportunities
 
7. Execute product holds in the system to prevent inadvertent release of non-conforming goods
 
8. Coordinate and execute activities related to Engineering Order, Quality Plan, Quality Improvement Project to support business needs, corporate strategies, and Global Quality objectives
 
9. Effectively communicate and collaborate with other departments as needed to achieve Quality Engineering and company goals
 
10. Resolve critical issues and contribute to organizational development
 
11. Define functional goals and objectives for the team and monitor performance throughout the year
 
12. Make strategic decisions based on company goals and objectives
 
13. Support internal and external inspections as Subject Matter Expert in front room
 
14. Control functional budget and expenses and responsible for resource allocation
 
15. Escalate quality and compliance issues to senior quality management and propose and work on effective solutions
 
16. Contribute to the design and improvements of workflows in the ERP software for processes related to product hold, traceability, and materials management
 
17. Comply with applicable Laws and Regulations, adhere to Quality Management System processes and requirements as well as demonstrate Ethics and Integrity in all matters and at all levels throughout the organization
 
18. Perform additional duties as assigned

 

### **Job Details**

Job ID 15046BR

Aliso Viejo, California, USA

Salary Range:

$179,788 - $224,735 Financial compensation packages may be higher/lower than what is listed, & will ultimately depend on factors including relevant experience, internal equity, skillset, knowledge, geography, education, business needs and market demand

 

* Qualifications

 1. Bachelor’s degree in a related field of study
 
 2. A minimum of twelve (12) years of related professional experience in quality, R&D and/or manufacturing
 
 3. A minimum of five (5) years of management or leadership experience
 
 4. Extensive medical device industry experience and business knowledge with comprehensive understanding of the organization and functional area
 
 5. Excellent command of FDA and ISO medical device quality system requirements
 
 6. Excellent knowledge of medical product manufacturing, process validation, test method validation, and risk management
 
 7. Excellent ability to provide technical leadership in evaluating product quality issues
 
 8. Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills
 
 9. Excellent in negotiating and influencing skills
 
 10. Proficient with MS Office Suite, SAP, and statistical software (preferably Minitab)
 
 11. Ability to be onsite 5 days a week
 
 
 Desired Qualifications
 
 1. Master’s degree in a related field of study
 
 2. Ability to understand the technology related to MicroVention’s products
 
 3. Experience with software used to manage quality information
 
 4. Experience with the auditing process
 
 
 Physical Qualifications
 
 1. Extended periods of computer use
 
 2. Extended periods of sitting, standing, or speaking
 
 3. Light lifting, up to 25 lbs
 
 4. May be required within the position to be in an environment that can include radiation exposure (such as in Cathlabs)
 
 5. Travel approximately 5 to 15%
 
 
 EEO
 
 We are an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, marital status or any other characteristics protected by law.
